description:
Perform an investigation search in ArkCase. Your goal is to find all active complaint cases related to the covert project 'Operation Nightshade' and compile a report.

1. Search for cases containing the phrase 'Operation Nightshade'.
2. Extract the Case Number, Complaint Title, and Priority for every matching case.
3. Create a JSON file at '/home/ga/Documents/nightshade_report.json' containing a list of these cases.

The JSON format must be an array of objects, e.g.:
[
  {
    "caseNumber": "COMP-2024-001",
    "title": "Security Breach - Operation Nightshade",
    "priority": "High"
  }
]

Do not include cases related to other projects (e.g., 'Project Bluebook').
